row.evidence: Syncro's SSO for technicians and admins is OpenID Connect that matches existing users by email; its pricing page, documentation centre and Swagger API reference describe no SCIM provisioning, and Syncro users are added manually under Admin > Users.
row.notes: New row. Syncro (now at syncrosecure.com) prices per technician: Core $129 and Team $179 per user/month billed annually, Enterprise/Custom via sales; a 14-day trial. Technician SSO is OIDC (tested with Okta, Google and Entra) and account-wide, but users must already exist with a matching email: no SCIM, no JIT and no IdP catalogue app found (okta.com/integrations/syncro/ 404, no Entra tutorial). The plan that includes SSO is not stated. The REST API (API key with custom permissions, 180 requests/min per IP, both plans) can only read technician users (GET /users, /users/{id}, /me). Syncro's Entra ID User Sync and M365 features manage the MSP's client tenants, not Syncro logins.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Adds multi-tenant M365 security and identity management for client tenants.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere (pricing, docs sitemap of ~500 articles, Swagger reference). scim.available is false by absence; the vendor never states 'no'.

auth.notes: API tokens with custom permissions (Security Permissions Reference), optional expiry; sent as api_key query parameter or bearer.

capabilities.notes: Swagger lists only GET for /users and /users/{id}; technician users are created and disabled in the UI. /portal_users covers client end-user portal accounts, not technicians.

rate_limits.text: 180 requests per minute per IP address

user_api.notes: The pricing page ticks Permission-Based API Access on both Core and Team (check icons in the comparison table).

okta.notes: No OIN page (okta.com/integrations/syncro/, /syncromsp/, /syncro-msp/ all 404); Syncro's guide has admins create their own OIDC app.

entra.notes: No Syncro tutorial in Microsoft Learn's SaaS app index; Syncro documents a custom OIDC app registration.

google.notes: Google Auth works as an OIDC IdP; no Google Workspace provisioning app.

fallbacks.notes: SSO only authenticates users whose Syncro email already matches the IdP; users are created manually and each added user is a paid licence.
